integrity: All mathematical statements and computations are presented as a same-model analytical review with reproducible numerical checks; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two independent arclength-uniform vertices on the unit circle and one fixed vertex in its closed disk; no generalized sampling law, strict total-radius monotonicity, or external historical-priority certification is claimed. Endpoints are continuous limits. The original area-uniform and Gaussian random triangle results are different sampling models.
title: Radial interpolation of random acute triangles: an exact mixed-circle law and a cusp at the center
